# Standing rules

<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- **Protect deep-work mornings.** No meetings before **11:00** unless it's an incident. Mornings are
  for code and design.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- **Never volunteer an unbuffered estimate**, and **never give rough dates to
  [Priya Anand](../people/priya-anand.md)** — see her file; she turns ballparks into public
  commitments.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- **Nothing outward without my explicit OK** — no email sent, no calendar invite created, no PR
  approved on my behalf. Draft it and show me.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- **On-call weeks:** protect focus even harder; assume reduced project throughput.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- **Money-path changes** (`ledger`/`settlement`) always get a careful review and tests — no rubber
  stamps, even for teammates.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- **Confidential = code name.** Anything sensitive (e.g. Aurora) is referred to only by code name.
